ops.text: CHANGELOG.md has been unmaintained since roughly 0.28: the version headings jump straight from `## [Unreleased]` (line 7) to `## [0.27.0]` (line 276), so about twenty releases — every 0.28 through 0.48.0 — accumulated inside the Unreleased section with no per-release heading, and the `[Unreleased]` link definition (line 1024) still compares against v0.25.0. The Unreleased body has now absorbed two full Added/Changed/Fixed cycles stacked on top of each other. This is not cosmetic: cutting v0.48.1 for the fusekit v1.15.4 helper-plist repin (2026-07-26) cost a full decision round, because "add a CHANGELOG entry matching the repo's existing shape" has two contradictory answers — the file's stated Keep a Changelog format versus what the last twenty releases actually did. The entry landed under Unreleased to avoid smuggling a process change into a fix release. Either restart the per-release discipline deliberately (backfill headings for the shipped versions, retarget the Unreleased link) or drop the Keep a Changelog claim from the header; the current in-between state makes every release ask the question again.
